I completed a roof-anchor inspection this morning, and the certified anchor at Harbor Roof only supports one performer — not two — and requires a fall-arrest harness. Pyrotechnics are also not permitted on the roof. This means the two-person aerial rig in the current draft plan is not safe or compliant. I haven't entered the inspection result into the production safety log yet, but I'm doing so now. We'll need to revise the aerial rig plan to a single performer, and ensure proper fall-arrest harnessing is in place.
